newsitem.title: USA: IGG Intl completes $2.6 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: IGG Intl completes $2.6 mln financing.

text.p: IGG International Inc said Friday it completed a $2.6 million fundraising effort.
The financing will provide the resources to sustain its two lead product development programs well into 1998, the company said.

The company said in a release that one of the programs is for GBC-590, for the treatment of cancer metastasis, which recently received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin Phase I clinical trials.

Regarding the other program, the company said it recently submitted an application for approval to the Environmental Protection Agency to begin marketing ELEXA in the U.S. as a naturally derived agricultural fungicide.
IGG International is a biotechnology company developing natural carbohydrate compounds for human therapeutics and agricultural applications.
